title: Event Timeline with BTreeMap
prompt:
Implement a Timeline that stores events keyed by a u64 timestamp, backed by a std::collections::BTreeMap so that range queries are efficient and ordered.

Methods:
- new() -> an empty timeline
- record(t, name): store event `name` at time t. If an event already exists at t, replace it and return the old name as Some(String); otherwise return None.
- between(a, b) -> Vec<&str>: names of all events with a <= t <= b, in time order. If a > b, return an empty Vec.
- latest_at_or_before(t) -> Option<(u64, &str)>: the most recent event at or before time t.
- first_after(t) -> Option<(u64, &str)>: the earliest event strictly after time t.

Hint: BTreeMap::range accepts ranges like a..=b, ..=t and (Bound::Excluded(t), Bound::Unbounded).

Example:
  record(10,"boot"), record(20,"login"), record(35,"logout")
  between(15, 40) -> ["login", "logout"]
  latest_at_or_before(34) -> Some((20, "login"))
  first_after(35) -> None
